comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks an opening limit; this record fills and assembles a moka pot for brewing.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a driver and wrench with countertorque; the record pours to a fill level, inserts the basket, and rotates a large threaded chamber to its seat.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks stop drift across cycles; the record checks water below the valve, basket presence, snug top, limited spill, safe carafe placement, and release.
comparison.reason: The shared threaded rotation is only a generic primitive; moka-pot assembly has no calibrated setting, jam nut, counterholding, or functional retention test.
